# WeGrow B School

> WeGrow B School is an entrepreneurship academy, skill campus, and business acceleration ecosystem based in Sivakasi and Srivilliputtur, Tamil Nadu. We provide hands-on business education, mentor-led growth programs, and diagnostic tools for business owners, women entrepreneurs, and student founders.

## Programs & Communities

- [Business Transformation Meetup](https://www.wegrowbschool.in/business-founders): Bi-weekly interactive meetups and workshops for business owners and MSME founders to scale revenue, streamline operations, and automate systems.
- [Women Entrepreneurs Community](https://www.wegrowbschool.in/womens-community): Comprehensive incubation and guidance community helping women start, manage, and scale independent businesses.
- [Student Founders Community](https://www.wegrowbschool.in/student-founders): Hands-on training and mentorship platform for college and school students to validate startup ideas and build real ventures.
- [Business Dependency Test](https://www.wegrowbschool.in/business-dependency-test): Diagnostic tool for entrepreneurs to measure owner dependency, team efficiency, and operational scalability.
- [Business Consultancy](https://www.wegrowbschool.in/consultancy): Tailored one-on-one business consultancy, marketing systems, and operational restructuring for growing companies.
